name: Content Snippets
description: Small editable text snippets stored as configuration, consumed via a PHP API, tokens, and Twig variables.
project_description: Content Snippets provides a simple way to make small bits of text that would otherwise be hard-coded in custom code, themes or forms editable by content editors without a developer or a deployment. An administrator defines named snippets (label, machine ID, storage type, help text, group, weight); content editors then fill in the values on a dedicated 'Snippets' page under Content. Each snippet is referenced by its machine name in three ways: the PHP function content_snippets_retrieve('id'), the token [content_snippets:id], or the Twig variable {{ contentSnippets.id }}. Snippet definitions live in the content_snippets.items config object and their values in content_snippets.content, so both are ordinary configuration that deploys with the codebase and is overwritten by a configuration import. Snippet types are Number, Line (plain text), Paragraph (plain text) and, when the Filter module is enabled, Paragraph (formatted), the last of which runs its value through a chosen text format on render.
